# RadioKit Arduino Library Reference

> For AI agents working with RadioKit on ESP32 projects.
> This document reflects the **rk fields** API (v2.0). All widget state is accessed through the `rk` struct. There are no `.get()`, `.set()`, `.clicked()`, `.isPressed()`, `.on()`, `.off()` methods.

## Quick Start

```cpp
#include <RadioKitLib.h>  // Single include for everything

// Declare widgets globally with minimal constructors (self-registering)
RK_PushButton btn(20, 60, 20);                      // x, y, height
RK_Slider slider(100, 60, 12, 80);                   // x, y, height, width
RK_LED led(20, 20, 15);                              // x, y, height
RK_Text display(20, 10);                             // x, y, height
RK_Joystick stick(160, 50, 40);                      // x, y, height
RK_Knob knob(170, 40, 30);                           // x, y, height
RK_SlideSwitch sw(20, 40, 10);                       // x, y, height
RK_ToggleButton toggle(20, 80, 15);                  // x, y, height
RK_MultipleButton modes(60, 30, 20);                 // x, y, height

void setup() {
    Serial.begin(115200);
    RadioKit.config.name = "MyDevice";
    RadioKit.config.description = "Controller";
    RadioKit.config.theme = RK_DEFAULT;
    RadioKit.config.password = "secret";  // Optional
    RadioKit.begin();
    RadioKit.startBLE("MyDevice");  // or startSerial(Serial)

    // Post-construction configuration via rk fields
    btn.rk.onText = "PUSH";
    btn.rk.offText = "IDLE";
    slider.rk.centering = RK_SPRING_CENTER;
    led.rk.color = 0x00FF00;
    led.rk.shape = RK_LED_SHAPE_CIRCLE;
    sw.rk.onText = "ON";
    sw.rk.offText = "OFF";
    sw.rk.labelHidden = true;
    modes.rk.items[0] = {"Auto", "cpu", 255};
    modes.rk.items[1] = {"Manual", "hand", 255};
    modes.rk.itemCount = 2;
}

void loop() {
    RadioKit.update();  // MUST call every loop iteration

    // Read inputs via rk fields
    if (btn.rk.state) { /* button is pressed/held */ }
    int8_t val = slider.rk.value;   // -100 to +100
    int8_t jx = stick.rk.xvalue;    // -100 to +100
    int8_t jy = stick.rk.yvalue;    // -100 to +100
    uint8_t sel = modes.rk.value;   // selected index (or bitmask for MultiSelect)
    bool switchOn = sw.rk.state;

    // Update outputs via rk fields
    led.rk.color = (val > 0) ? 0x00FF00 : 0xFF0000;
    led.rk.state = (val != 0);
    display.rk.content = "Speed: 42";
}
```

## Library Metadata

- **Version**: 2.0.0 (Protocol v5)
- **Platform**: ESP32 (esp32 architecture)
- **Dependencies**: NimBLE-Arduino (BLE), WebSockets (WiFi/Cloud)
- **License**: MIT
- **Max widgets**: 16 per device

## Widget Types & rk Fields

Each widget has a public `rk` struct that holds all configurable and readable state. Set fields before `RadioKit.begin()` for initial values, or anytime after.

### Spatial Fields (all widgets)

Every `rk` struct includes these spatial fields, set by the constructor and reassignable:
```
uint8_t  x, y          // Position on virtual canvas (0-200)
uint8_t  height         // Height in grid units
uint8_t  width          // Width (0 = auto from aspect ratio)
int16_t  rotation       // Degrees, default 0
```

### RK_PushButton / RK_ToggleButton

```cpp
RK_PushButton btn(x, y, height, width = 0, rotation = 0);
RK_ToggleButton toggle(x, y, height, width = 0, rotation = 0);

// rk fields (RK_ButtonFields):
bool        state       // Read: pressed/on state. Write: set initial state.
const char* icon        // Icon name string (Lucide icons)
const char* onText      // Text when ON (push: "PRESSED", toggle: "ON")
const char* offText     // Text when OFF (push: "RELEASED", toggle: "OFF")
const char* label       // Display label
```

| Widget | Input | Output |
|--------|-------|--------|
| PushButton | bool (momentary) | - |
| ToggleButton | bool (latched) | - |

### RK_Slider / RK_GasPedal

```cpp
RK_Slider slider(x, y, height, width = 0, rotation = 0);
RK_GasPedal gas(x, y, height, width = 0, rotation = 0);
// GasPedal auto-sets variant to alt shape + spring center

// rk fields (RK_SliderFields):
int8_t      value       // -100 to +100
uint8_t     centering   // RK_SPRING_NONE, RK_SPRING_CENTER, etc.
uint8_t     detents     // Snap positions (0 = continuous)
const char* label       // Display label
```

| Widget | Input | Output |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Slider | int8 (-100..+100) | - |
| GasPedal | int8 (spring-center) | - |

### RK_Joystick

```cpp
RK_Joystick stick(x, y, height, width = 0, rotation = 0);

// rk fields (RK_JoystickFields):
int8_t      xvalue      // X-axis -100 to +100
int8_t      yvalue      // Y-axis -100 to +100
bool        enabled     // Enable/disable joystick
uint8_t     centering   // Spring centering mode
const char* icon        // Icon name
const char* label       // Display label
```

| Widget | Input | Output |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Joystick | 2x int8 (-100..+100) | - |

### RK_Knob / RK_SteeringWheel

```cpp
RK_Knob knob(x, y, height, width = 0, rotation = 0);
RK_SteeringWheel wheel(x, y, height, width = 0, rotation = 0);
// SteeringWheel auto-sets variant to alt shape

// rk fields (RK_KnobFields):
int8_t      value       // -100 to +100
uint8_t     centering   // Spring centering mode
uint8_t     detents     // Snap positions (0 = continuous)
int16_t     startAngle  // Arc start in degrees, default -135
int16_t     endAngle    // Arc end in degrees, default 135
const char* icon        // Icon name
const char* label       // Display label
const char* centerIcon  // Center icon (steering wheel hub)
```

| Widget | Input | Output |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Knob | int8 (-100..+100) | - |
| SteeringWheel | int8 (spring-center) | - |

### RK_SlideSwitch / RK_RockerSwitch

```cpp
RK_SlideSwitch sw(x, y, height, width = 0, rotation = 0);
RK_RockerSwitch rocker(x, y, height, width = 0, rotation = 0);

// rk fields (RK_SlideSwitchFields):
bool        state       // ON=true, OFF=false
const char* onText      // Label when ON (default "ON")
const char* offText     // Label when OFF (default "OFF")
const char* icon        // Icon name
const char* label       // Display label
bool        labelHidden // Hide the label in UI
```

| Widget | Input | Output |
|--------|-------|--------|
| SlideSwitch | bool | - |
| RockerSwitch | bool | - |

### RK_LED

```cpp
RK_LED led(x, y, height, width = 0, rotation = 0);

// rk fields (RK_LedFields):
bool        state       // ON=true, OFF=false
uint32_t    color       // 0xRRGGBB (use RK_RED, RK_GREEN, etc.)
uint8_t     shape       // RK_LED_SHAPE_CIRCLE/SQUARE/DIAMOND/STAR
uint8_t     ledState    // RK_LED_STATE_OFF/ON/BLINK/BREATHE
uint16_t    timing      // Blink interval in ms (default 500)
const char* label       // Display label
```

| Widget | Input | Output |
|--------|-------|--------|
| LED | - | 5 bytes (state, R, G, B, opacity) |

### RK_Text / RK_Serial / RK_SerialMonitor

```cpp
RK_Text text(x, y, height, width = 0);
RK_Serial serial(x, y, height, width = 0);
RK_SerialMonitor monitor(x, y, height, width = 0);

// rk fields (RK_TextFields):
const char* content     // Text content (assign string literal)
const char* label       // Display label

// RK_Serial extends both RK_Text (widget) and Print (Arduino Print):
serial.println("Hello");  // Print API works
serial.rk.content = "Update";  // Direct rk field for push
```

| Widget | Input | Output |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Text | - | dynamic UTF-8 string |
| Serial | - | dynamic (Text + Print subclass) |

### RK_MultipleButton / RK_MultipleSelect

```cpp
RK_MultipleButton btn(x, y, height, width = 0, rotation = 0);
RK_MultipleSelect sel(x, y, height, width = 0, rotation = 0);

// rk fields (RK_MultipleFields):
uint8_t     value       // Selected index (Button) or bitmask (Select)
uint8_t     variant     // 0=Segments, 1=Grid, 2=Wheel
RK_Item     items[8]    // Item pool: {label, icon, pos}
uint8_t     itemCount   // Number of active items
const char* label       // Display label

// Setting up items:
modes.rk.items[0] = {"Auto",   "cpu",  255};  // pos=255 = auto
modes.rk.items[1] = {"Manual", "hand", 255};
modes.rk.items[2] = {"Off",    "off",  255};
modes.rk.itemCount = 3;
```

| Widget | Input | Output |
|--------|-------|--------|
| MultipleButton | uint8 (index) | - |
| MultipleSelect | uint8 (bitmask) | - |

### RK_Telemetry

```cpp
RK_Telemetry telem("sensor_label");  // Constructor takes label string

// rk fields (RK_TelemetryFields):
const char* content     // Dynamic text value
const char* icon        // Icon name
const char* unit        // Unit string (metadata)
const char* label       // Display label

// Update the value:
telem.rk.content = "42.5 °C";
```

| Widget | Input | Output |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Telemetry | - | dynamic UTF-8 string |

## Communication Transports

### BLE (Default)

```cpp
RadioKit.startBLE("DeviceName");  // Starts BLE advertising
```

- Uses NimBLE-Arduino library
- 6 BLE characteristics for different protocols
- Advertising name prefixed with `RK_`
- Best for mobile app connections

### Serial

```cpp
RadioKit.startSerial(Serial);  // or Serial1, etc.
```

- Works with any Arduino Stream
- Recommended baud: 1000000
- Connection detection: 3s timeout after last packet

### WiFi

```cpp
RadioKit.config.sta_ssid = "MyNetwork";
RadioKit.config.sta_password = "MyPass";
RadioKit.startWiFi();  // Requires -D RADIOKIT_ENABLE_WIFI
```

- WebSocket server on port 5555
- AP mode: SSID `RK_<name>` (always open)
- STA mode: connects to configured network
- mDNS advertising (`_radiokit._tcp`)

### Cloud

```cpp
RadioKit.config.cloud_url = "wss://relay.example.com:443";
RadioKit.config.cloud_account = "<64-char-hex-public-key>";
RadioKit.startCloud();  // Requires WiFi + -D RADIOKIT_ENABLE_WIFI
```

- WebSocket client to Rust relay server
- Ed25519 authentication
- Auto-reconnect with exponential backoff

## Multi-Transport

Multiple transports run simultaneously. `isConnected()` returns true if ANY transport is connected.

```cpp
RadioKit.startBLE("Device");
RadioKit.startSerial(Serial);
RadioKit.startWiFi();  // All three active
```

## Configuration

```cpp
RadioKit.config.name = "DeviceName";        // Max 32 chars
RadioKit.config.description = "Description"; // Max 128 chars
RadioKit.config.password = "secret";         // Max 32 chars, optional
RadioKit.config.theme = RK_DEFAULT;          // UI skin
RadioKit.config.orientation = RK_LANDSCAPE;  // or RK_PORTRAIT
RadioKit.config.width = 0;                   // Canvas width (0=auto)
RadioKit.config.height = 0;                  // Canvas height (0=auto)
RadioKit.config.baudrate = 1000000;          // Serial baud rate
RadioKit.config.device_icon = "zap";         // Icon name from kDesignerIcons
```

### Themes

`RK_DEBUG`, `RK_DEFAULT`, `RK_FUTURISTIC`, `RK_RETRO`, `RK_MILITARY`, `RK_CYBERPUNK`, `RK_NEON`, `RK_MINIMAL`

### Widget Styles

`RK_PRIMARY`, `RK_DIM`, `RK_SUCCESS`, `RK_WARNING`, `RK_DANGER`

## Authentication

Two-level password system:
- **Device password**: Full access (FS, OTA, settings, widgets)
- **User password**: Widgets-only access (requires device password set first)

```cpp
RadioKit.config.password = "admin";     // Device password (in RADIOKIT.h)

// In runtime:
RadioKit.setConfig(nullptr, nullptr, "newpass", "userpass");  // Set or change passwords
uint8_t result = RadioKit.authenticate("password");
// Returns: 0x00 (device/full), 0x01 (user/widgets-only), 0x02 (denied)
```

No password set = pre-authenticated (full access). Passwords persist in NVS across reboots.

## LED Widget

### Colors

```cpp
RK_OFF   = 0x000000
RK_RED   = 0xFF0000
RK_GREEN = 0x00FF00
RK_BLUE  = 0x0000FF
RK_YELLOW = 0xFFFF00
```

### Shapes

`RK_LED_SHAPE_CIRCLE` (0), `RK_LED_SHAPE_SQUARE` (1), `RK_LED_SHAPE_DIAMOND` (2), `RK_LED_SHAPE_STAR` (3)

### States

`RK_LED_STATE_OFF` (0), `RK_LED_STATE_ON` (1), `RK_LED_STATE_BLINK` (2), `RK_LED_STATE_BREATHE` (3)

### Example

```cpp
RK_LED led(20, 20, 15);
led.rk.color = RK_GREEN;
led.rk.shape = RK_LED_SHAPE_CIRCLE;
led.rk.ledState = RK_LED_STATE_BLINK;
led.rk.timing = 500;  // Blink interval ms
led.rk.state = true;  // Turn on
```

## Spring/Centering Modes

For knobs, sliders, and gas pedals:

```cpp
RK_SPRING_NONE    = 0  // No spring return
RK_SPRING_CENTER  = 1  // Springs to 0
RK_SPRING_MIN     = 2  // Springs to -100
RK_SPRING_MAX     = 3  // Springs to +100
```

## Filesystem (LittleFS)

The filesystem is auto-mounted in `RadioKit.begin()`. No explicit `beginFs()` call needed.

```cpp
RadioKit.formatFs();   // Format filesystem (destructive)
```

- FS capability is advertised via feature bit (bit 1 of features bitmask)
- Bulk file operations via BLE/WiFi (0xAA protocol)
- Max payload: 16KB per frame
- Operations: LIST, READ, WRITE, DELETE, MKDIR, RENAME, FORMAT, REPLACE, CRC32

### Error Codes

`OK` (0), `NOT_FOUND` (1), `IO_ERROR` (2), `NO_FS` (3), `ACCESS_DENIED` (4), `INVALID_PATH` (5), `OUT_OF_SPACE` (6), `INVALID_STATE` (7)

## OTA Updates

Firmware updates via BLE/WiFi (0xBB protocol):
- Max chunk: 4KB
- Progress reported every ~5% or 50 chunks
- Deferred erase flag for NVS+FS wipe after OTA

## Print/Debug Output

```cpp
RadioKit.print("text");
RadioKit.println("line");
RadioKit.printf("val: %d", 42);
```

- Transport-agnostic (sends to all connected transports)
- Circular buffer: 1024 bytes
- Flushes on newline or buffer full
- Received as 0xEE frames on the app side

## Limits

```
RADIOKIT_MAX_WIDGETS  = 16
RADIOKIT_MAX_LABEL    = 32 chars
RADIOKIT_MAX_ICON     = 24 chars
RADIOKIT_MAX_NAME     = 32 chars
RADIOKIT_MAX_DESC     = 128 chars
RADIOKIT_MAX_PWD      = 32 chars
RADIOKIT_MAX_USER_PWD = 32 chars
RADIOKIT_TEXT_LEN     = 32 chars
RADIOKIT_MAX_ITEMS    = 8 items
RADIOKIT_MAX_SSID     = 32 chars
RADIOKIT_MAX_WIFI_PWD = 64 chars
RADIOKIT_MAX_CLOUD_URL = 128 chars
RK_MAX_PACKET_SIZE    = 768 bytes
```

## Important Notes

1. **Always call `RadioKit.update()` in loop()** — Required for protocol handling, shadow comparison, and print buffer flushing.
2. **Widgets are self-registering** — Declare globally, no manual registration needed.
3. **Max 16 widgets** — Excess widgets are silently dropped.
4. **State changes are automatic** — The `update()` loop compares `rk` struct against `_shadow` and pushes any changes. No need to call explicit update methods.
5. **Auth resets on disconnect** — Re-authenticate after transport reconnects.
6. **NVS persists config** — First boot uses compile-time defaults, subsequent boots read NVS. Use `pio run -t erase` if NVS needs to be erased.
7. **Device UID auto-generated** — 16 hex chars from `esp_random()` on first boot.
8. **Transport enable flags** — BLE (`rk_ble_on`), WiFi (`rk_wifi_on`), Cloud (`rk_cloud_on`) stored in NVS. Set to 0 to disable a transport permanently.

## Designer-Generated Code

The RadioKit Designer tool generates `RADIOKIT.h` files containing:
1. JSON config in `/*__RADIOKIT_Designer_Config__...*/` comments
2. Generated widget declarations using minimal constructors
3. `rk` field assignments in `initRadioKit()` for labels, icons, colors, etc.

This file is meant to be edited by the Designer tool, not by hand. The JSON config is parsed by the Flutter codegen to reconstruct the canvas layout.

## Error Handling

- **Auth rejection**: Returns `0x02` (denied)
- **CRC failure**: Packets silently discarded
- **Buffer overflow**: Print buffer drops oldest bytes
- **Transport disconnect**: Auth state resets
- **NVS unavailable**: Falls back to compile-time defaults
- **FS unavailable**: All FS commands reply with `NO_FS` error code
